example_translation.en: Hello! How are you?
example_translation.de: Hallo! Wie geht es dir?
example_translation.fr: Bonjour ! Comment vas-tu ?
example_translation.ja: こんにちは！お元気ですか？

example_translation.en: Thank you for your help!
example_translation.de: Danke für deine Hilfe!
example_translation.fr: Merci pour ton aide !
example_translation.ja: 助けてくれてありがとう！

example_translation.en: He is my best friend.
example_translation.de: Er ist mein bester Freund.
example_translation.fr: Il est mon meilleur ami.
example_translation.it: Lui è il mio migliore amico.
example_translation.ja: 彼は私の親友です。

example_translation.en: I'm going home now.
example_translation.de: Ich gehe jetzt nach Hause.
example_translation.fr: Je rentre à la maison maintenant.
example_translation.ja: 今、家に帰ります。

example_sentence: Posso ter um copo de água, por favor?

example_translation.en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
example_translation.tr: Bir bardak su alabilir miyim, lütfen?
example_translation.es: ¿Puedo tener un vaso de agua, por favor?
example_translation.de: Kann ich ein Glas Wasser haben, bitte?
example_translation.fr: Puis-je avoir un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît ?
example_translation.it: Posso avere un bicchiere d'acqua, per favore?
example_translation.ja: 水を一杯いただけますか？

example_translation.en: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
example_translation.de: Guten Morgen! Hast du gut geschlafen?
example_translation.fr: Bonjour ! Tu as bien dormi ?
example_translation.ja: おはようございます！よく眠れましたか？

example_translation.en: Can you help me, please?
example_translation.de: Können Sie mir bitte helfen?
example_translation.fr: Pouvez-vous m'aider, s'il vous plaît ?
example_translation.ja: 助けていただけますか？

example_sentence: Não entendo o que você quer dizer.

example_translation.en: I don't understand what you mean.

example_translation.ja: あなたの言いたいことがわかりません。

example_translation.en: I have a lot of work today.
example_translation.de: Ich habe heute viel Arbeit.
example_translation.fr: J'ai beaucoup de travail aujourd'hui.
example_translation.ja: 今日はたくさん仕事があります。

example_translation.en: I always wake up early.
example_translation.de: Ich stehe immer früh auf.
example_translation.fr: Je me réveille toujours tôt.
example_translation.ja: 私はいつも早く起きます。

example_translation.en: The movie was quite interesting.
example_translation.de: Der Film war ziemlich interessant.
example_translation.fr: Le film était assez intéressant.
example_translation.it: Il film è stato abbastanza interessante.

example_translation.ja: 新しい戦略を開発する必要があります。

example_sentence: É caro; no entanto, vale a pena.

example_translation.en: It's expensive; however, it's worth it.
example_translation.es: Es caro; sin embargo, vale la pena.

example_translation.fr: C'est cher ; cependant, ça vaut le coup.
example_translation.it: È caro; tuttavia, ne vale la pena.

example_translation.en: You should take advantage of this opportunity.
example_translation.de: Du solltest diese Gelegenheit nutzen.

example_translation.en: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
example_translation.es: A pesar de la lluvia, salimos a caminar.
example_translation.de: Trotz des Regens gingen wir spazieren.
example_translation.fr: Malgré la pluie, nous sommes allés nous promener.
example_translation.it: Nonostante la pioggia, siamo andati a fare una passeggiata.
example_translation.ru: Несмотря на дождь, мы пошли на прогулку.
example_translation.ja: 雨にもかかわらず、散歩に出かけました。
example_translation.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是去散步了。

example_sentence: A comunicação é indispensável para este cargo.

example_translation.zh: 沟通对这个职位来说是不可缺少的。

example_sentence: Este projeto vai acarretar muita pesquisa.

example_sentence: O projeto é ambicioso; não obstante, é viável.

example_translation.fr: Le projet est ambitieux ; néanmoins, il est réalisable.

example_sentence: As tensões que subjazem ao conflito são complexas.

example_translation.ru: Напряжённости, лежащие в основе конфликта, сложны.
example_translation.ja: 紛争の根底にある緊張は複雑です。
example_translation.zh: 冲突背后的紧张关系很复杂。
